method: Built-in image_gen; original Wise signature composited with sharp, preserving the complete source image; WebP derivative for website.

prompts.investment-foundations: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished standalone website series-cover image for the topic "Investment foundations: understanding stocks, bonds, funds and indices". Landscape exactly 2:1 aspect ratio. Full-width coherent physical scene, not a small isolated icon. High-end silver-white glass 3D product visualization matching a bright financial education website: thick optical glass, polished silver aluminum, restrained fine champagne-gold trims, bright neutral white architectural studio with vertical translucent glass panels and gentle daylight, realistic refractions and contact shadows. Central subjects large and readable at 400px thumbnail: a beautifully made open educational book in white and silver, three translucent glass securities/certificate sheets standing just behind the book, with only minimal engraved abstract symbols distinguishing a company share, bond coupon, and fund basket; small glass building blocks grouped together convey different asset types. Clear hierarchy, very few objects. No money wallet, no monitors, no rocket, no arrows promising returns, no podiums, no trophy, no invented numeric charts. Subjects within 8% safe edges and mostly central-lower area, occupy ~70% frame width. Keep the top right 20% width by 17% height plain for a brand signature to be added from an original file afterward. No text, letters, watermark or logo. Neutral white not beige, no dark navy background, no gradients, no neon. Output a single finished landscape artwork, not website UI and not a collage.
